title: Deliver notifications to every recipient of a large audience
description: A notification sent to a large audience reached only part of it. Mail servers refuse more than a handful of simultaneous connections from one sender, and the portal opened a separate one for every message, so the rest were rejected and lost. Every recipient now receives them. The new optional MAIL_MAX_CONNECTIONS sets how many the portal may open; the default is ten, and some mail servers accept as few as three. A message that fails temporarily is retried for several minutes, so mail that was lost now arrives late; one that cannot be delivered is reported with its recipient. Whether mail can be reached is reported at startup.
